description: Job Title: 1st Shift Quality Assurance Analyst (Float Role) Job Description The 1st Shift Quality Assurance Analyst (Float Role) ensures that products consistently meet the highest standards of quality and safety in alignment with industry regulations and internal policies. This role supports multiple areas of the facility, performing audits, inspections, and testing to verify compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and state regulations. The analyst plays a key role in maintaining food safety programs, verifying documentation, and partnering with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and uphold a strong quality culture. Responsibilities Perform routine quality assurance and quality control activities across designated production areas during 1st shift as a float resource. Conduct inspections and case audits to verify product quality, labeling accuracy, and adherence to specifications and standards. Verify Certificates of Analysis (COAs) for incoming materials and finished products to ensure they meet defined quality and safety requirements. Execute microbiological testing and environmental monitoring activities to assess product and facility hygiene conditions. Support and maintain compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and applicable state regulations through daily oversight and documentation. Monitor and verify critical control points within HACCP plans to ensure food safety controls function effectively. Review batch records and related quality documentation for completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance. Conduct self-inspections, internal audits, and mock recalls to test the effectiveness of quality and food safety systems. Participate in root cause analysis for quality and food safety issues, and help implement corrective and preventive actions. Collaborate closely with operations, sanitation, maintenance, and other teams to resolve quality concerns and improve processes. Document quality findings, deviations, and inspection results clearly and accurately in accordance with company procedures. Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, food safety, and overall compliance. Assist in maintaining and updating quality and food safety documentation, including procedures, records, and audit reports. Be available to provide quality support during audits or food safety emergencies, including occasional overtime and weekend coverage when needed. Essential Skills Experience in quality assurance and quality control within a regulated manufacturing or food production environment. Working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and their application in daily operations. Hands-on experience with inspection and quality analysis activities in a production or laboratory setting. Practical understanding of HACCP principles, including monitoring and verification of critical control points. Familiarity with SQF, FDA, and state regulatory requirements related to food safety and quality. Experience with

Job Title: GIS Analyst Job Description The GIS Analyst will support Operation Services, an internal department that aids construction projects. The role involves completing engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for various main and service works, collecting construction activity 'as-built' data with mobile CPS devices in the field, creating permanent asset records, and editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. The analyst will also perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before posting, represent Engineering at project meetings, and conduct field visits to job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Responsibilities Complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for all types of main and service work. Collect construction activity 'as-built' using mobile CPS devices in the field for creating permanent asset records. Edit map features and correlating attribute data in the GIS. Perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before it is posted to the GIS. Represent Engineering at internal and external project meetings as required. Visit job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Perform preliminary reviews of development plans and interface with customers. Implement and train Engineering staff on new work processes for the GIS mapping system. Distribute and update maps for other departments as requested. Approve requests for the acquisition and release of easements and vacation of rights-of-way. Perform pipeline safety compliance-related GIS analysis as directed. Execute all other duties as assigned. Essential Skills Proficiency in ArcGIS and CAD. Knowledge of geography and construction drawings. Experience with as-built drawings, cost forecasting, and drafting. Additional Skills & Qualifications Ability to complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS. Experience in collecting construction activity 'as-built' data using mobile CPS devices. Skill in editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. Work Environment The role is based in a professional engineering office, initially requiring attendance five days per week, reducing to three days per week after training. Work may be performed in both office and field settings, with exposure to the elements. Typical hours are 7:00 a.m. to 3:45 p.m., Monday through Friday, with potential for overtime and travel. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $25.00 - $27.00/hr. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Job Title: Grain Quality Analyst Job Description As a Grain Quality Analyst, you will be responsible for the identification and preparation of incoming grain samples. You will ensure that all samples are correctly labeled and that appropriate analytical tests have been requested. Your role will involve preparing and analyzing samples according to ISO work instructions, while also prioritizing analyses based on customer needs. You will organize and coordinate projects within a high throughput laboratory environment, ensuring the integrity of analytical data and delivering laboratory results efficiently. Responsibilities Identify and prepare incoming grain samples, ensuring correct labeling and requested analysis. Analyze samples following ISO work instructions. Prioritize analyses according to customer needs and lab capacity. Organize and coordinate projects in a high throughput lab environment. Ensure data integrity and deliver laboratory results efficiently. Function effectively within multi-discipline teams. Essential Skills Proficiency in laboratory work with skills in chemistry and biology. Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Biology, or a closely related field. At least three years of related industry experience. Ability to follow instructions and pre-established guidelines. Additional Skills & Qualifications Experience with total combustion analysis, elemental analysis, and calorimetry. Familiarity with Gas Chromatography (GC), NIR Spectroscopy, and NMR. Hands-on experience with total oil analysis, colorimetry, falling number, and farinograph. Proficiency in wet chemical analyses, LIMS, and Microsoft Office Suite. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered in lieu of degree requirements. Work Environment The work schedule is Monday to Friday on the first shift. The position requires working under immediate supervision and typically reporting to a supervisor. The work environment is a high throughput laboratory setting that emphasizes collaboration within multi-discipline teams. Job Type & Location This is a Contract position based out of Ankeny, IA. Microbiology Lab Analyst Job Description The Microbiology Lab Analyst serves as a Laboratory Technician responsible for performing analytical and microbiological testing on food products, ingredients, and environmental samples to support quality and safety programs. You will apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to ensure accurate, reliable results and help maintain compliance with regulatory and customer requirements. Working primarily on second shift, you will prepare and analyze samples, maintain a clean and organized laboratory, monitor and care for equipment, and assist with inventory and quality-related duties. Responsibilities Perform analytical and microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, and environmental samples in accordance with approved methods and protocols. Apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to evaluate indicator organisms, pathogens, and relevant chemistries. Prepare and analyze samples for indicator organisms, pathogens, and chemical parameters, ensuring accuracy and proper documentation. Notify laboratory management promptly of any deviations, out-of-specification results, or unusual findings in test results. Maintain appropriate inventory levels of reagents, media, consumables, and supplies required for testing activities. Provide routine preventive maintenance, basic troubleshooting, and thorough cleaning of laboratory equipment to ensure reliable operation. Support quality-related duties, including performing temperature checks, monitoring controls, and verifying proper storage conditions. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and customer requirements while following relevant regulatory and industry guidelines. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment using proper aseptic techniques and good laboratory practices. Stay current with scientific literature, emerging technologies, and industry trends related to food microbiology and analytical testing. Accurately record, interpret, and report test results in accordance with laboratory documentation standards. Collaborate with colleagues and other departments to support continuous improvement in laboratory processes and quality systems. Essential Skills Bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, or a closely related science field. At least 2 years of experience in a commercial food-testing or analytical laboratory. Hands-on experience with microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, or environmental samples. Proficiency in aseptic sampling techniques and routine laboratory procedures. Knowledge of laboratory equipment operation, care, and basic troubleshooting. Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Working knowledge of OSHA safety requirements in a laboratory environment. Experience with FDA, BAM, APHA, ISO, or USP methods relevant to microbiology or analytical testing. Ability to follow detailed protocols and standard operating procedures accurately. Strong attention to detail

Candidates should have a Bachelors Degree in a Scientific discipline and at least 6 months of experience working in a regulated laboratory or similar environment. Candidates with a PhD level education will not be considered. Job Description The Quality Specialist will be supporting a regenerative nerve and medicine laboratory by performing desk based document review, handling CAPAs, investigations, deviations, and performing other duties to ensure proper regulations and protocols are being followed. Responsibilities Perform reviews of batch production records and manufacturing records as part of lot release activities. Coordinate and track Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Non-Conforming Report (NCR), and Deviation records, ensuring all tasks are completed on time. Coordinate and track the site environmental monitoring (EM) testing program. Assist teams in coordinating problem solving and root cause analysis for quality events. Maintain accurate and complete records of Quality Control activities in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP). Provide support related to gowning qualification and training. Ensure timely issuance, review, and approval of microbiology and environmental monitoring testing results. Interface with colleagues to ensure effective corrective and preventive actions are implemented for recurring product or process discrepancies. Assist in the review and approval of equipment qualifications. Assist in the review of calibration and preventive maintenance activities. Assist in hosting onsite regulatory audits and inspections. Qualifications Bachelors degree in a scientific discipline. Minimum of 6+ months of experience working in a heavily regulated industry. Job Title: Business Analyst Location: Boston, MA Hybrid Work Arrangement: Hybrid Duration: 1+ Year Role Summary The client is seeking a Business Analyst with strong Prior Authorization (PA) expertise to support MMIS initiatives within a large healthcare benefits environment. The role focuses on claims processing, provider reimbursement, requirements management, testing, implementation support, and stakeholder collaboration for projects supporting member services and regulatory compliance. Key Responsibilities Lead and participate in joint application design sessions with business stakeholders. Gather, document, analyze, and validate business and system requirements. Support design, development, testing, implementation, and stabilization activities across MMIS projects. Develop testing strategies, test scenarios, and test cases; execute and review testing activities. Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to ensure business requirements are fully defined and validated. Communicate project updates, system changes, and impacts to stakeholders. Provide MMIS functional support and respond to business questions and concerns. Perform data analysis and data query activities to support project objectives. Required Qualifications Business analysis experience supporting multiple phases of the SDLC. Strong healthcare claims processing knowledge, including Prior Authorization (PA), PAS, and referrals. Experience working with Medicaid programs, healthcare payer environments, or MMIS platforms. Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities. Experience creating requirements documentation, test cases, and testing strategies. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with business, technical, QA, and vendor teams. Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, IT, Healthcare Administration, or related discipline, plus relevant experience. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of Agile methodologies. Understanding of HIPAA claims and payment transaction processing. Familiarity with interoperability concepts and X12 transaction standards. Previous state Medicaid or government healthcare program experience. Additional Information Hybrid work arrangement with onsite expectations. Focused on regulated healthcare systems supporting Medicaid operations. Candidate should be comfortable engaging with multiple stakeholder groups and vendors. ROLE INTERPRETATION & HIRING NEED ANALYSIS Actual Need: Business Analyst with deep healthcare claims processing expertise, specifically Prior Authorization (PA) within a Medicaid/MMIS environment. Business Goal: Support enhancements, compliance-driven changes, testing, and implementation efforts impacting member-facing healthcare services. Hidden Priority: Domain expertise in Medicaid claims operations appears more important than generic BA experience. Potential Knockout Factors: Lack of PA/claims processing experience, MMIS exposure, Medicaid knowledge, or SQL/d
